title: Capability block 4: Human-in-the-loop approval system

body:
## Capability block 4: Human-in-the-loop approval system

Built a client-facing dashboard and approval flow where clients could inspect a live-accurate preview, make inline edits, and publish. Client approval directly triggered publication and confirmation, removing the internal team as intermediary while preserving the final human decision.

Output and impact:

- Reduced approval-to-publish time from days to under 60 seconds.
- Turned the final decision into client self-service.
- Consolidated pending approvals, published inventory, and operational information in one interface.

Maintainability evidence:

- The workflow has an explicit human control point before external publication.
- Approval is a defined state transition rather than an informal message passed between teams.
- The same approval contract works across clients.
